sig: [[["A", "Hello, this message is for Mr. Daniel Ortiz in suite 410. This is Fiona Clarke, the building manager at Harbour Tower."], ["A", "I'm calling to give you a heads-up about some repairs in the underground car park."], ["A", "Starting next Monday, the fifth, contractors will be repairing cracks in the concrete on levels B1 and B2."], ["A", "The work should take about two weeks, weather permitting."], ["A", "During that time, those two levels will be completely closed."], ["A", "I know that's not ideal, especially since your team uses six of the spaces on B2."], ["A", "We've arranged temporary parking at the City Centre garage on Elm Street, about a five-minute walk away."], ["A", "There's no charge for tenants; you'll just need to show a visitor pass at the entrance."], ["A", "I can have passes ready for your team, but I need the names and licence plate numbers of everyone who'll be parking there."], ["A", "Could you email that list to me by Wednesday?"], ["A", "If you have any questions, you can reach me on extension 225. Thanks very much."]], {"A": "F-GB"}]
